slots.name: title
slots.about: the screen title

slots.name: night_text
slots.about: the line over the times, naming the night

slots.name: start
slots.about: copied into state: the bedtime to start from, minutes after midnight (0 to 1439)

slots.name: end
slots.about: copied into state: the wake time to start from, minutes after midnight

slots.name: step
slots.about: minutes one tap moves a time

slots.name: min_len
slots.about: the shortest night in minutes, more than 0

slots.name: max_len
slots.about: the longest night in minutes, under 1440

slots.name: goal
slots.about: the night length aimed for, in minutes

slots.name: from_label
slots.about: the bedtime row's name

slots.name: to_label
slots.about: the wake row's name

slots.name: from_clock
slots.about: the bedtime in words; may read start_h (0 to 23) and start_m

slots.name: to_clock
slots.about: the wake time in words; may read end_h and end_m

slots.name: len_line
slots.about: the worked-out length; may read len_h and len_m

slots.name: goal_line
slots.about: the line under it; may read met, short_h, short_m and goal

slots.name: limit_line
slots.about: why a stepper is dim; may read at_longest and at_shortest

slots.name: kept_title
slots.about: the heading once kept

slots.name: week_line
slots.about: the line under it; may read nights, avg_h, avg_m and nights_met

slots.name: from_back
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: bedtime one step earlier

slots.name: from_on
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: bedtime one step later

slots.name: to_back
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: wake time one step earlier

slots.name: to_on
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: wake time one step later

slots.name: save
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: keeps the night for today, replacing today's if there is one

slots.name: edit
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: back to the steppers

empty.shows: the steppers from the slot times; once kept, week_line reads one night

attention.shows: the two steppers that would pass the limit dimmed, and limit_line saying which limit

fallback.shows: a check, kept_title, the length and the 7-night line, and the edit button

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink, swap and rise
accessibility.not_colour_alone: a stepper at its limit is dimmed and limit_line says why; the goal line says short or met in words
